description.value: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort, established in 1904, is one of the oldest resorts in BC, situated on Knouff Lake roughly 45 minutes from Kamloops. The family-run resort offers rustic log cabins with cast iron wood cook stoves, RV/tent camping, and fishing in a lake that holds a North American fly fishing record. Access requires a 14.6 km dirt road off Tod Heffley Louis Creek Road, making it a remote wilderness destination rather than a roadside stop.

address.value: 9608 Knouff Lake Road, Heffley Creek, British Columbia V0E 1Z1, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names a single chalet 'Lake View,' which matches the 'LAKEVIEW' cabin listed on the Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort website. The website confirms this is an active 4-season wilderness resort with rustic cabins, RV/tent camping, and various outdoor activities near Kamloops. Access requires 14.6 km of dirt road, which is a significant concern for touring cyclists. Wi-Fi is confirmed at the Lodge only. Laundry is mentioned only in the Redwood Cottage. No bike storage, bike procedure, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
